interface.signature: isPossible(N: int, P: int, prerequisites: List[List[int]]) -> bool

preconditions.expression: isinstance(N, int) and N >= 1 and N <= 10**4
preconditions.description: N is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(P, int) and P >= 0 and P <= 10**5
preconditions.description: P is an integer between 0 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(prerequisites, list) and all(isinstance(pair, list) and len(pair) == 2 for pair in prerequisites)
preconditions.description: prerequisites is a list of pairs, where each pair is a list of two integers.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= pair[0] < N and 0 <= pair[1] < N for pair in prerequisites)
preconditions.description: Each task in the prerequisite pairs is a valid task label between 0 and N-1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (len(prerequisites) == 0 or not any(cycle_exists(N, prerequisites, start) for start in range(N)))
postconditions.description: The function returns true if there is no cycle in the task dependency graph, otherwise false.
